clauses.reason: The operative paragraph of Executive Order 8368 further exempts Ales Hrdlicka from compulsory retirement for age under section 204 of the act of June 30, 1932, for a term it states as 'for a period of one year ending March 31, 1941'. The exemption is a fixed-term command, so it ends by its own terms on the stated date, 1941-03-31. The date is recorded inclusive, as the exemption runs through the end of March 31, 1941; the exclusive reading, under which the term ends when that day begins, is the alternative. The grant is personal to one named person and nothing in the held text makes it depend on a report, an event or a later order. A later order, Executive Order 8710 dated March 12, 1941, recites this order and grants a further exemption 'for a period of one year ending March 31, 1942'. It is recorded as a later event with its own date. It is a separate command and does not end this order's term, which is the stated term of this order alone. The recital cites the earlier exemption order Executive Order 8058 of February 23, 1939 as predecessor; it precedes this order and are not events affecting it.
